verdict.rationale: Salesforce's AgentExchange page says users can plug third-party MCP servers directly into Agentforce Builder, and Sales Cloud pricing includes access to AgentExchange. That gives Sales Cloud's agents a documented route to MCP servers, but the support sits in the Agentforce layer and rests on a single marketing statement. The salesforcecli/mcp repo is a server-side offering and is not credited here. Missing for 10: setup or configuration docs for registering an MCP server, evidence of how agents invoke MCP tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: you can find, evaluate, and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents, and MCP servers directly within Agentforce Builder
